front.title: Destination-IP-Origin-AS Filter for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) Flow Specification (FlowSpec) to enable filtering based on the Origin Autonomous System (AS) of the destination IP address. This extension is particularly useful in mitigating Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks or optimizing traffic redirection where the target IP addresses are numerous or rapidly changing, but belong to a specific destination Origin AS.
